headline: Anthropic Ventures into Drug Development with Claude Science and In-House Research
reasoning: This topic is highly relevant to tech, showcasing a major AI company's direct entry into a new, complex field. It's newsworthy due to Anthropic's significant shift from purely software to drug development, indicating a meaningful trend in AI application. Readers will find it valuable for understanding the evolving landscape of AI and its real-world impact beyond traditional tech products.
summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Science, an AI workbench for scientists, and announced its intention to develop its own drugs, focusing on neglected diseases. This move positions a major AI company as a direct competitor in the drug discovery space, alongside selling AI tools to other pharmaceutical companies.
